subject: sync.mjs: every mode except reverse-delta refuses --dry-run before any connection; extract.mjs normalizeHtmlNoise: the dpl strip stops at a backslash

nonBlocking.issue: scripts/migration/db/sync.mjs:55-93 (parseArgs, unchanged): unknown flags are silently ignored, so near-miss spellings of the flag are not dry-runs. `delta --dry-run=true`, `delta --dryrun` and `delta -n` all got past the refusal and reached connect(). I checked this offline with unset env-var names: all three failed with 'Missing required env var', which only happens once the real delta has started. So an operator who types --dry-run=true gets a real forward delta. The impact is low because delta is the normal, idempotent forward sync to Neon. For reverse-delta, `--dry-run=true` is still stopped by the two write guards. Fix: make parseArgs reject unknown flags, or at least anything starting with --dry or equal to -n.

scripts/migration/parity/lib/extract.mjs:23: neither the old nor the new regex strips a dpl value in JSON-escaped form (`&dpl=`), or a value that starts with a backslash. I scanned the real bodies: 301 in p8 raw-b, 297 in p6 raw-b and 297 in p6 raw-a. Every dpl occurrence is `?dpl=`, and after the new normalization no dpl= or dpl_ tokens remain. So this is theoretical today. A later Vercel build that emits `&dpl=` would leave a deployment-id token in the normalized HTML.

Side effect of this review: running scripts/migration/parity/selftest-p5.3.mjs with no --out writes its default output to docs/migration/evidence/P5.3-parity-selftest.json (selftest-p5.3.mjs:265). My run created that untracked file at 10:21:05Z. It is not part of the implementer's change, and I left it in place as the rules require. The orchestrator should leave it out of the P8.3 commit or remove it. The default output path in that self-test is itself a small footgun.

I did not re-run the live selftest.mjs against https://www.growmax.io. For tie-permutation-real-data I relied on the implementer's run artifacts (docs/migration/.scratch/p83-footguns/selftest-live*.json). The offline selftest-dpl-strip.mjs (4/4) and my own scan of the real Vercel bodies cover the same code path. The run-1 failures were a 'retried' count on /_next/image factory-floor.jpg, which normalizeHtmlNoise cannot affect.

main() refuses --dry-run before it dispatches on mode, so an unknown mode given with --dry-run reports '<mode> has no dry-run' instead of 'Unknown mode'. It still exits 1 without connecting. This is cosmetic only.

reviewerSummary:
Approve with no blocking findings. The implementer's fix is correct and in scope. The working tree changes only sync.mjs, db/selftest.mjs and parity/lib/extract.mjs, plus the new untracked selftest-dpl-strip.mjs and the implementer's evidence file. runReverseDelta and parseArgs are unchanged.

**(1) sync.mjs.** refuseDryRun (sync.mjs:100) is the first statement of verify, runGap, runDelta, runFullRefresh, runInitWatermarks and initWatermarksForTables. In runInitWatermarksPostCutover it follows only a const label. main() also calls it before the switch for every mode except reverse-delta (:1376). So the refusal comes before every guard, STATE read, DNS lookup and connect(). The exported entry points that take args are all covered; runGapVerifyInit and initWatermarksFromCutoverBaseline are not exported. No workflow, runbook or SPEC-03 text uses --dry-run with any mode other than reverse-delta.

I ran db/selftest.mjs myself on a throwaway local PG16 (127.0.0.1:55433, under /tmp, stopped and deleted afterwards), with the real-DB env vars unset. It passed 37/37. Scenario 33: delta --dry-run left target rows, sync_state and sync_log identical, and all 6 CLI modes exited 1 with an empty stdout. Scenario 34: reverse-delta --dry-run still plans (rowsAboveGap 1, moved 0) and leaves the source unchanged.

Mutation check: the same selftest against HEAD's sync.mjs, in a scratch copy, fails only scenario 33. There, delta --dry-run wrote 1 post and 1 demo row, moved both watermarks to 1 and wrote 4 sync_log rows. The offline guards still pass: readonly-url 5/5, runner-guards 7/7, schema-diff 44/44.

Residual, non-blocking: parseArgs ignores unknown flags, so `delta --dry-run=true`, `--dryrun` and `-n` still run a real delta.

**(2) extract.mjs.** The new character class is the old one plus a backslash. Every new match is therefore a prefix of an old match, and anything the new regex removes the old one also removed. The change can only keep more text, so it cannot hide a difference the old regex exposed.

I scanned the real bodies (p8 raw-b 301, p6 raw-b 297, p6 raw-a 297):
- Replit (raw-a) contains no "dpl" at all, so Replit normalization and hashing cannot change.
- On Vercel, every one of the 11,703 dpl occurrences is `?dpl=`. The value is followed by `"` + space (3,616), `"/` (219) or the RSC escaped quote `\"` (7,868).
- After the new normalization, no dpl= or dpl_ tokens remain in any body.
- Keeping the backslash makes Vercel's `x.js\"` match Replit's `x.js\"`, so the result is more faithful to Replit, not less.

The P8.2 compare result is explained. compare.mjs imports only sha256Text, normalizeText, safeFileName and CANONICAL_PRODUCTION_HOSTS from extract.mjs, never normalizeHtmlNoise. Its stdout, "Compared 301 URLs: FAIL (failedUnallowed=4, allowlisted=4)", matches P8.2. p83-reextract.json shows extractDiffers empty on both sides, and extractEmbeddedBlogPosts on the normalized Vercel /blog went from an error to 172 posts, equal to the raw body. Offline parity self-tests I ran: selftest-dpl-strip 4/4, c-a3b-5 12/12, link-header 21/21, p5.3 12/12. I did not re-run the live selftest.

My run of selftest-p5.3.mjs wrote an untracked docs/migration/evidence/P5.3-parity-selftest.json through its default --out. I left it in place; it should not go into the P8.3 commit.
